english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the feeling that something desired may happen.
Use this when the wish is chiefly a hope or expectation that something will happen.
Use this for the future-hope or prospect sense, especially when something good may happen.

examples.english: We lost the first match, but we still have hope of qualifying.
examples.traditional: 輸咗第一場，我哋仲有希望出線。
examples.jyutping: syu1 zo2 dai6 jat1 coeng4 ngo5 dei6 zung6 jau5 hei1 mong6 ceot1 sin3

examples.english: I wish it wouldn't rain tomorrow.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 hei1 mong6 teng1 jat6 m4 hou2 lok6 jyu5

examples.english: This new job gives me hope and the expectation of a better life.
examples.traditional: 呢份新工畀我對未來有希望，同埋有更好生活嘅期望。
examples.jyutping: ne1 fan6 san1 gung1 bei2 ngo5 deoi3 mei6 loi4 jau5 hei1 mong6 tung4 maai4 jau5 gang3 hou2 saang1 wut6 ge3 kei4 mong6
